The USB-ready ZIP includes default.xex and Assets/blades.xzp together.
Extract Blades-v0.36-USB.zip onto USB and launch Blades/default.xex.
Separate artwork pack downloads are available for manual updates. No conversion is required. See docs/DASHX360-ASSETS.md for sources and attribution.
Optional retail 5766 shared artwork: shrdres.xzp is tried when blades.xzp cannot load.
Missing/invalid resources use embedded fallbacks. Artwork and notices are included in the combined ZIP and separate pack.
